text:
alex-eng: Anyone in payroll? My Aug net pay is -$128. I think a retro health premium was charged twice and my 401k deferral looks doubled. I moved to Ireland July 1 — worried about W-2/withholding. Screenshot/snippet below. Help?

devin-peopleops: cc @maria-payroll — can you take a look? Also need to confirm if payroll converted to contractor for international pay. @payroll-bot

maria-payroll: looking now. @alex-eng can you DM last4 SSN and confirm pay period? Also paste the paystub snippet here if you can.

alex-eng: sure, pay period 7/31-8/15. snippet:```
Gross: $6,500.00
Pre-tax 401k: $975.00
Health premium retro: $125.00
Health premium retro: $125.00  <-- duplicate
Taxes withheld: $1,200.00
Net: -$128.00
YTD 401k: $19,500.00
```

maria-payroll: ok I see the duplicate deduction and the YTD 401k is at the annual limit. Looks like the system didn't zero out deferral after the limit hit. We'll open a correction.

maria-payroll: creating ticket now — PR-78912. Plan: reverse duplicate premium, run off-cycle correction for net pay, then process corrective distribution for excess 401k (taxable adj). We'll annotate payroll for W-2/W-2c if needed.

alex-eng: I was never converted to contractor — I'm still an employee. Does the Ireland move change FICA/social security or 401k eligibility? Concerned about treaty and withholding.

devin-peopleops: we need residency docs uploaded (relocation acceptance + proof of IRL residency start date). @maria-payroll can advise on totals/SS.

maria-payroll: short answer: until legal confirms totalization, FICA may still apply for US payrolled employees in Ireland. For now we will: 1) reverse duplicate premium in the next 2 business days, 2) issue off-cycle net correction next payroll run (ETA next Wed 8/10), 3) process corrective distribution for 401k excess in the following month and prepare W-2c if required. I'll confirm exact dates after legal check.

payroll-bot: Ticket PR-78912 created by maria-payroll. Status: Investigating. ETA owner update 1708530000.

alex-eng: :relieved: thank you. Please confirm tax withholding impact once steps are firmed up.

maria-payroll: DM received for SSN last4. Will update this thread with timelines and any W-2/W-2c implications. If anyone else needs access to the paystub, ping me.
